'''''Compositio Mathematica''''' is a monthly [[Peer review|peer-reviewed]] [[mathematics journal]] established by [[Luitzen Egbertus Jan Brouwer|L.E.J. Brouwer]] in 1935.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.compositio.nl/stichting2.html |title=Foundation Compositio Mathematica}}</ref> It is owned by the Foundation Compositio Mathematica, and since 2004 it has been published on behalf of the Foundation by the [[London Mathematical Society]] in partnership with [[Cambridge University Press]]. According to the ''[[Journal Citation Reports]]'', the journal has a 2020 2-year [[impact factor]] of 1.456 and a 2020 5-year impact factor of 1.696.<ref name=WoS>{{cite book |year=2020 |chapter=Journals Ranked by Impact: Mathematics |title=Journal Citation Reports |publisher=[[Thomson Reuters]] |edition=Science |series=[[Web of Science]] |title-link=Journal Citation Reports }}</ref>

The [[editors-in-chief]] are Fabrizio Andreatta, David Holmes, Bruno Klingler, and Éric Vasserot.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.compositio.nl/editors.html#editors |title=Editorial Board of Compositio Mathematica}}</ref>

== Early history ==
The journal was established by L. E. J. Brouwer in response to his dismissal from ''[[Mathematische Annalen]]'' in 1928.<ref name=Hist>{{cite journal |url=https://www.cambridge.org/core/services/aop-cambridge-core/content/view/FD99C36FE416A49D6BA6985696106AAF/S0010437X06002351a.pdf/birth_and_youth_of_compositio_mathematica_ce_periodique_foncierement_international.pdf |title=The Birth and Youth of Compositio Mathematica: "Ce périodique foncièrement international" |author=Dirk van Dalen, Volker R. Remmert |journal=Compositio Mathematica |volume=142 |issue=5 |year=2006 |pages=1083–1102 |doi=10.1112/s0010437x06002351|doi-access=free }}</ref> An announcement of the new journal was made in a 1934 issue of the ''[[American Mathematical Monthly]]''.<ref>{{cite journal |jstor=2300351 |title=News and Notices |journal=American Mathematical Monthly |volume=41 |issue=2 |year=1934 |pages=120–122|doi=10.1080/00029890.1934.11987522 }}</ref> In 1940, the publication of the journal was suspended due to the [[History of the Netherlands (1939–1945)|German occupation of the Netherlands]].<ref name=Hist/>
